title: Thai-Style Pide Potato Cakes
description: A creative twist on traditional Thai cuisine, these crispy potato cakes are infused with the flavors of Turkish pide and creamy luxurious touches.

ingredients.name: turkish spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated potatoes, diced pide, softened cream cheese, and turkish spices. Mix well to combine.
Add chopped green onions to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into 8-10 patties.
Heat coconut oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 4-5 patties to the skillet and flatten slightly with a spatula.
Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
